name: Road King Infrastructure Limited
summary: Road King Infrastructure Limited, founded in 1994 and headquartered in Tsim Sha Tsui, Hong Kong, is an investment holding firm developing and managing real estate and toll highways, mainly in China. Its divisions are property development and investment, toll roads, and investment and asset management. It operates eight expressways totaling around 600 kilometers, five in mainland China and three in Indonesia, and also provides financial and management advisory services.
